title.en: Heat diffusion along a rod with fixed end temperatures

summary: Watch an exact temperature mode decay while the rod itself stays geometrically fixed.
objective: Show heat diffusion in a one-dimensional rod with fixed cold ends, a temperature probe and an analytic profile.
intent_signals: Show heat diffusion in a one-dimensional rod with fixed cold ends, a temperature probe and an analytic profile.
Watch an exact temperature mode decay while the rod itself stays geometrically fixed.
example_prompts: Show heat diffusion in a one-dimensional rod with fixed cold ends, a temperature probe and an analytic profile.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of heat equation rod with probe and clock.
negative_signals: Only one-dimensional constant-diffusivity conduction with fixed end temperatures; no radiation, convection or phase changes.
not_for: Only one-dimensional constant-diffusivity conduction with fixed end temperatures; no radiation, convection or phase changes.

entities.name: Rod and end reservoirs
entities.guidance: Use a straight segmented cylinder with an unbroken silhouette and clearly marked fixed-temperature end clamps; segment color samples the same field as the graph.

entities.name: Temperature profile
entities.guidance: Place a linked x-temperature curve beside the rod, with a fixed legend in kelvin excess or degrees of temperature difference.

entities.name: Probe and clock
entities.guidance: Slide a probe along x; display exact current temperature, model time and decay time L*L/(kappa*pi*pi).

state_contract.model: For 0<=x<=L, L>0 and diffusivity kappa>0, temperature excess u=A*sin(pi*x/L)*exp(-kappa*(pi/L)^2*t), A>=0,t>=0. Ends have zero excess; T=Tbase+u.
state_contract.authority: Analytic field evaluation owns rod colors, temperature profile and probes. The rod does not deform or move because temperature changes.
actions: Change amplitude, positive length or diffusivity while resetting time.
Play, pause or scrub nonnegative time.

invariants: Both ends remain at the baseline temperature.
For A>=0 the interior excess remains nonnegative and does not increase with time.
Doubling length at fixed diffusivity multiplies the decay time by four.
motion_guidance: Evaluate the analytic solution at model time, not by blending between arbitrarily chosen color frames.
Use a fixed temperature legend across playback so cooling remains visible.
known_limits: Only one-dimensional constant-diffusivity conduction with fixed end temperatures; no radiation, convection or phase changes.
The amplitude is an initial condition, not a continuously active heater; temperature color is not visible incandescence.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Zero-endpoint heat-equation sine modes decay exponentially, with decay rate proportional to diffusivity and the square of spatial frequency.
claims.scope: Constant coefficient u_t=kappa*u_xx with homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries.

object_craft.structure: Use a straight segmented cylinder with an unbroken silhouette and clearly marked fixed-temperature end clamps; segment color samples the same field as the graph.
object_craft.material: Neutral rod geometry beneath a perceptually ordered thermal palette; end clamps remain a fixed reference, without emissive glow implying radiation.

physical_contract.scope: Analytic one-dimensional heat field; no numerical solver or mechanical deformation.
colliders: No rigid-body colliders; any boundary is part of the declared mathematical model.
driving: Conduction equation with fixed temperature boundaries.
contact: No collision or impact response is supplied by this field model.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate the declared analytic state at paused or running model time; rendering never advances a second model.
checks: At one decay time the central excess is A/e.
